ot_s81dv_xfin.why: S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24: the S81 xfin master is fed by xrt x_si, whose bit 7 is constant 0 (max index 59) and was dropped; ot_s81dv_xfin SIW = 7 (default) takes s_i[6:0], s_i[7] = 0 inside (ot_s81dv_norm and DV benches pass SIW = 8)

dsfd_su_t_rxsb.why: o_r = sqrt(sp) >= 0: sign bit constant 0; port narrowed to o_r[30:0]

ot_s81sl_vs.why: receiver of rxsb o_r[31]; port narrowed to ra_ri[30:0], vs uses {1'b0, ra_ri}; applies to both tables of module ot_s81sl_vs (ot_s81sl_vs.json and the re-pinned ot_s81sl_vs_lfp.json + its stub LEF)

dsdv_bksel_c.why: S81-KITS-RTLC 10-24 coordinator ruling (b) 'drop' (bk_col has no consumer in v4.8): the dsfd_selt_c vd word of the S81 bk_sel select control is {kind 4 (3/4/5/7), seg_tag 8, 145 x 0, ...}: vd[513] (kind msb) and vd[501:357] are constant 0 at the producer (raw face_guard: TIELO), and vd[0] (rst copy) has no reader in dsdv_bk_g; dsdv_bksel_c vd and dsdv_bk_g vd (VD_PK = 1) are packed to vd[366:0] = {vd[512:502], vd[356:1]} at both ends ('rename'); legacy plana / bk_col parents use dsdv_bk_g VD_PK = 0
